title: The Avenger
subtitle: A Wedding Shadows Old Secrets and New Danger
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi attends a quiet wedding in a remote town, festivities quickly take a backseat to intrigue. As old friends gather and unexpected guests arrive, a hidden mystery begins to unravel—one that only the legendary Truth Seeker can solve. Step into a world where every celebration may conceal a deeper, darker truth.
